name: Disformal-Frame Bimetric MOND (DFBM): Hassan-Rosen Chassis with e^-y Screened A_0 Slip and Independent Massive-Graviton Kinetic
claimed_mechanism: This architecture exits the local single-metric dead class by employing a Hassan-Rosen bimetric gravitational sector, where the physical matter couples to g_mu_nu and a hidden f_mu_nu sector mediates a massive graviton (m ~ H_0). The MOND dynamics and lensing carrier are split: the auxiliary chi generates the exact mu=1-e^-y force law on g_mu_nu, while the preferred-frame vector u_mu sources the off-ray (Phi, Psi) slip required by DC-013 to achieve correct MOND lensing. The PPN-visible slip coupling to u_mu is strictly multiplied by e^-y, ensuring the Solar System is fully screened from preferred-frame violations, while the kinetic normalization of the massive graviton remains finite and independent (controlled by the HR V(g,f) potential mass term).
predicted_weak_field: In the weak-field limit, the g_mu_nu sector recovers GR with exponentially small e^-y corrections in the high-acceleration regime, yielding G_eff/G_N=1. In the deep MOND regime (y<<1), the force law is enhanced by 1/mu(y) ~ 1/y, while the lensing potential is boosted by the e^-y screened A_0 component of u_mu. The massive graviton (c_T=1) ensures no post-Newtonian speed-of-light violation, and the PPN parameters alpha_1, alpha_2 are suppressed by e^-y ~ 10^-15 in the Solar System, satisfying Cassini and pulsar timing bounds.
inequivalence_argument: This is structurally distinct from DC-001/DC-012/DC-013 because it explicitly abandons the single-metric constraint (I2), which is the exact premise of the slip-lock theorem. It is distinct from DC-002 (AeST) because the preferred-frame coupling is dynamically screened by e^-y rather than constant, and the kinetic normalization of the propagating massive graviton is independent of the screened slip. It is distinct from DC-010 (khronometric) because it uses a standard Hassan-Rosen bimetric chassis with c_T=1 and a massive graviton, avoiding the khronon strong-coupling wall (P7) where the screened factor e^-y vanishes the kinetic term. The bimetric sector provides the 'multi-sector' separation of MOND dynamics (chi on g) from the lensing carrier (u_mu slip + massive graviton).
